test_hydrogen_train: test the hydrogen.train function with default parameters for 2D hydrogen atom training
test_hydrogen_exact_lapl: test hydrogen.train with exact Laplacian by setting laplacian_eps to 0.0
test_hydrogen_pfor_per_example: test hydrogen.train with parallel_for and per-example Jacobian strategy enabled
test_hydrogen_exact_lapl_pfor: test hydrogen.train with exact Laplacian, parallel_for, and per-example Jacobian
run_hydrogen_cli: run the hydrogen example CLI with configurable flags for training iterations and batch size
